name: misarreach
description: Find leads, enrich contacts, run multi-channel outreach sequences, and manage your sales pipeline — from any AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
MisarReach lets you run sales prospecting from ChatGPT. Search for and enrich leads, discover companies that match your ideal customer, verify email addresses, preview personalised outreach, add leads to campaigns, and manage deals across your pipeline.

It is built for founders and sales teams who prospect with MisarReach. A MisarReach account is required, and the plugin only works with the signed-in account's own leads, campaigns and deals.
defaultPrompt: Find 10 leads who are VP of Marketing at SaaS companies.
Show the status of my autopilot outreach runs.
Open a new deal for a lead in my pipeline.

positive.prompt: Show my ten most recently saved leads.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to ten saved leads with name, company and email.

positive.prompt: Check whether jane@example.com and john@example.com are deliverable.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a deliverability result for each of the two addresses.

positive.prompt: Show my sales pipeline by stage.
positive.expected_behavior: Return deals grouped by pipeline stage with revenue totals.
Confirm a new deal worth $5,000 was created for that lead.

positive.prompt: Find SaaS companies in Germany with 50 to 200 employees.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching companies with name, domain, size and location.

negative.description: General sales concept question, no prospecting action
negative.prompt: What is the difference between a lead and an opportunity in a sales pipeline?

negative.description: Personal message writing; no lead search or outreach
negative.prompt: Draft a short LinkedIn note thanking a recruiter I met at a conference.

negative.description: Local business lookup, not B2B prospecting
negative.prompt: Find the opening hours and phone number of the nearest pharmacy.

review.commerce_description: MisarReach does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Adds the Misar task skills, OAuth sign-in, and updated branding.
